newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Perilya lifts gold resource, reserve.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Perilya lifts gold resource, reserve.

text.p: Perilya Mines NL said on Tuesday it had increased its gold reserve and resource base by 247,000 ounces following the results of exploration work at the Fortnum and Moyagee properties in Western Australia.

The first boost came from the Starlight deposit at Fortnum, where an interim reserve and resource of 813,000 tonnes of ore, grading 4.5 grams of gold a tonne, or 125,00 ounces, has been recorded, perilya said. Fortnum's reserves currently stand at 3.3 million tonnes, grading an average of 2.5 grams of gold/t, containing 270,300 ounces, the company said.
